normalized.description: The Mhlanga lab, as of September 2020 to be the Department of Cell Biology at the Radboud Institute for Molecular Life Sciences, has the need to further improve and increase its quantitative and qualitative capabilities for spatial transcriptomics and proteomics. To achieve this, we intend to purchase an Optical Biosystems StellarVision, a High Resolution proprietary Synthetic Aperture Optics (SAO) based technology that is the only product in the market that offers the resolution similar to 100x oil immersion lens simultaneously with the large Field of View (FOV), large Depth of Field (DOF), and long Working Distance (WD) of 20x/0.45NA dry high lens. Imaging data can be collected, processed, and analysed to quantify individual RNA molecules across 100,000+ single cells in 0.3 - 0.5 cm2 tissue sections. Optical Biosystems has demonstrated a robust and automated method for detecting 30 gene targets via smRNA FISH with sub-cellular resolution across large tissue sections. Unlike previous methods, these technology improvements ensure that researchers do not have to choose between speed or resolution when conducting experiments in spatial genomics. As the methods undergo further rigorous validation, Optical Biosystems is developing additional features for the near future that also will benefit the Mhlanga Lab. Formalin Fixed Paraffin Embedded (FFPE) tissues & single cellsHigh-background tissuesMultiple organismsAdditional RNAs, including non-coding RNAs, mitochondrial RNAs, introns, splice variantsDNA, including chromatin structureHigher plex of up to 100 genesBroader coverage of the whole transcriptomeSmaller gene targetsSoftware for large-scale visualization and annotationAutomated spot detection and quantificationAutomated nuclei segmentation The instrument's optical design, which is protected by multiple patents (US Patents: 8,222,040; 8,502,867; 8,759,077; 8,796,185; 8,817,362; 9,458,501; 9,465,228), synergistically combines a low magnification lens on the fluorescence emission path and a series of high-resolution laser interference patterns on the excitation path. Using the 20x dry high lens, StellarVision can perform high-throughput, non-contact scanning of large areas (e.g., whole tissue section or entire microplate) at resolution of conventional 60x or higher oil immersion lens, a capability that is not obtainable in similar products in the market.

Следгаранционната поддръжка на софтуера на системи за управление на въздушното движение – ATM обхваща системи за обработка на радарна информация и полетни планове (Air Traffic Management – ATM, Radar Data Processing System – RDPS/FDPS, Central&work station и визуализирането на радарна информация във формата на ASTERIX Cat.62) от състава на КИНС на летищата на ВВС Граф Игнатиево, Крумово, Безмер и изнесено работно място във военно формирование 28540 – Труд по приложен списък – Приложение № 1 към ТС С 93.3975.22. Оказване на техническа помощ за разрешаване на проблеми по телефон, факс, имейл адрес или посещение на място. Осигуряване на софтуерни процедури на място (инсталиране на пачове (набор от промени на софтуера за подобряване на работата), инструкции за запускане и други), при възникнали откази; Периодично обновяване (инсталиране на актуална база данни, ъпдейти) на текущия софтуер, включително и отстраняване на грешки. Инсталиране на нови софтуерни версии, модернизации (надграждане/ъпгрейд) на текущите и разширения на възможностите на софтуера за управление на въздушното движение. Отстраняване на софтуерни грешки, възникнали в етапа на функциониране на системите за управление на въздушното движение и възстановяването на тяхната работа. The following categories of vehicles and associated services are to be provided under the prospective framework contract: • Small transportation cars with a minimum of four seats; • Transportation cars with a minimum of five seats; • Minivans. Frontex intends to establish one framework contract per lot as follows: Lot 1 - Bulgaria; Lot 2 - Greece and Cyprus; Lot 3 - Slovenia, Croatia, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania and Kosovo
